newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks rise slightly in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks rise slightly in late trade.

text.p: Taiwan share prices were up but off earlier highs in late Tuesday trade on weak sentiment and profit-taking by short-term investors.
At 0320 GMT, with 40 minutes to go, the weighted index rose 25.28 points, or 0.31 percent, to 8,294.71. Turnover was T$56 billion.

"The stock market is in a vacuum period. Many investors had sold shares they believed were over-valued, and they have not found new investment targets," said Joe Chiou, an analyst of Taiwan Securities Investment.
The overnight rise on Wall Street had no major impact, brokers said.
Electronics companies in northern Hsinchu Science-based Industrial Park faced selling because many firms' operations were forced to shut down due to a 20-minute power outage on Monday.
